page_title: TOR 3-0 NAP | Torino v Napoli 07/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Antonio Sanabria will be replaced by Demba Seck (Torino).
90+1' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes a shot which is well saved by the goalkeeper.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
90' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) replaces Ivan Ilic.
90' Today's match ends for Nikola Vlasic who will be replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
87' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Referee Maurizio Mariani sees the trip by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
82' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
81' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Napoli, play can continue.
80' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Torino. Let’s see what happens!
80' Surely that's handball by one of the Napoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
78' A pass by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
77' Substitution. Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) has come on for Jens Cajuste.
76' Here is a change. Koffi Djidji is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Saba Sazonov (Torino).
76' Substitution. Duvan Zapata is replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
76' The linesman raises his flag. Duvan Zapata (Torino) is adjudged offside.
74' The Napoli players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
71' Torino enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
68' Here comes a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Politano.
66' 3 - 0 Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top right corner. The score is 3:0.
66' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.

65' What a chance that is! Antonio Sanabria (Torino) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
61' The foul by Juan Jesus (Napoli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Maurizio Mariani.
60' One of the Napoli players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
59' Walter Mazzarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replacing Giacomo Raspadori.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alessio Zerbin (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Mario Rui cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' The Torino players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession.
56' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
50' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

49' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli), but referee Maurizio Mariani must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
48' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
48' That was close! Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
48' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
46' The second half has just started.
46' Walter Mazzarri makes a half-time substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi comes on in place of Piotr Zielinski (Napoli).
45+2' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 0 Goal! Duvan Zapata displays great vision and sends a pass to Antonio Sanabria (Torino), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
42' Napoli are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
40' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' A yellow card for a tackle by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
34' Torino keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
31' The Torino players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
28' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

26' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
24' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
21' A short pass finds Nikola Vlasic (Torino) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
19' Torino players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
16' Neat passing move from Torino in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Half-chance! Valentino Lazaro (Torino) plays a pass into the box, but Pierluigi Gollini reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
10' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.

5' A sweet pass finds Duvan Zapata (Torino) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Pierluigi Gollini is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
3' One of the players from Napoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Torino will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
